<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
<!-- This site is hosted on Netlify. Anyone can build and deploy a site
     like this one for free: https://netlify.new/?utm_campaign=loops&utm_source=ai-legible&utm_medium=owned&utm_content=comment&utm_id=a12b51a4-e25d-4f27-a518-fbeb0bde9515
     Netlify hosting facts for this site: static/SSR served via Netlify Edge. -->
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>CSR Call Evaluator — Upload & Auto-Score Call Recordings</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --navy: #1a2a4a;
            --navy-light: #243355;
            --red: #c0392b;
            --red-light: #e74c3c;
            --green: #1e7e4a;
            --green-light: #27ae60;
            --gold: #d4a017;
            --bg: #f4f5f7;
            --card: #ffffff;
            --border: #dde1e9;
            --text: #1c2333;
            --muted: #5a6478;
            --pass-bg: #eafaf1;
            --fail-bg: #fdf0ee;
            --radius: 10px;
            --shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.08);
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* HEADER */
        .header {
            background: var(--navy);
            padding: 18px 32px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            border-bottom: 3px solid var(--red);
            gap: 16px;
        }
        .header-title {
            color: white;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .header-sub {
            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 400;
            opacity: 0.7;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .home-link {
            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
            text-decoration: none;
            opacity: 0.8;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
            padding: 7px 14px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.15s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .home-link:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); opacity: 1; }

        .main { max-width: 920px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 20px 70px; }

        .card {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            padding: 22px 24px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .card-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        /* STEPS */
        .steps {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }
        .step {
            flex: 1;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 9px 6px;
            border-radius: 7px;
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .step.active {
            background: var(--navy);
            border-color: var(--navy);
            color: white;
        }
        .step.done {
            background: var(--pass-bg);
            border-color: #a9dfbf;
            color: var(--green);
        }

        /* UPLOAD */
        .dropzone {
            border: 2px dashed var(--navy);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            background: #fbfcfd;
            padding: 34px 20px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
        }
        .dropzone:hover, .dropzone.dragover {
            background: #eef2f9;
            border-color: var(--red);
        }
        .dropzone-icon { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .dropzone-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .dropzone-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
        #audioInput { display: none; }

        .file-chip {
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            background: var(--pass-bg);
            border: 1px solid #a9dfbf;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 14px 16px;
        }
        .file-chip.show { display: flex; }
        .file-chip .f-icon { font-size: 26px; }
        .file-chip .f-meta { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .file-chip .f-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .file-chip .f-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
        .file-chip .f-remove {
            background: none;
            border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
            background: white;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 7px 14px;
            font-size: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: inherit;
            color: var(--muted);
        }
        .file-chip .f-remove:hover { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }

        .fallback-link {
            display: block;
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 14px;
            font-size: 12.5px;
        }
        .fallback-link a { color: var(--navy); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }
        .fallback-box { display: none; margin-top: 14px; }
        .fallback-box.show { display: block; }
        .fallback-box textarea {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 130px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            resize: vertical;
            outline: none;
        }
        .fallback-box textarea:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }

        /* META GRID */
        .meta-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .meta-field label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .meta-field input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 9px 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            background: #fbfcfd;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.15s;
        }
        .meta-field input:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }
        .meta-field input.required-missing { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--fail-bg); }

        /* BUTTONS */
        .btn {
            padding: 12px 26px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 7px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
        }
        .btn-primary { background: var(--navy); color: white; }
        .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }
        .btn-primary:disabled { background: #9aa4b8; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .btn-red { background: var(--red); color: white; }
        .btn-red:hover { background: var(--red-light); }
        .btn-ghost {
            background: white;
            color: var(--navy);
            border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
        }
        .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }
        .actions-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-top: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        /* MESSAGES */
        .msg {
            display: none;
            padding: 13px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .msg.show { display: block; }
        .msg.error { background: var(--fail-bg); border: 1px solid #f5b7b1; color: #7c1d12; }
        .msg.success { background: var(--pass-bg); border: 1px solid #a9dfbf; color: #14532d; }

        /* PROGRESS */
        #progressSection { display: none; text-align: center; padding: 40px 24px; }
        .spinner {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border: 4px solid #e3e7ef;
            border-top-color: var(--red);
            border-radius: 50%;
            margin: 0 auto 18px;
            animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .progress-stage { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); }
        .progress-hint { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; }
        .progress-track {
            height: 6px;
            background: #e3e7ef;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin: 20px auto 0;
            max-width: 380px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .progress-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 15%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy), var(--red));
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: width 0.5s ease;
        }

        /* RESULTS */
        #resultsSection { display: none; }

        .grade-banner {
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            border: 2px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--card);
            padding: 24px 26px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .grade-banner.pass { background: var(--pass-bg); border-color: var(--green-light); }
        .grade-banner.fail { background: var(--fail-bg); border-color: var(--red-light); }
        .grade-label { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; color: var(--muted); }
        .grade-value {
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 52px;
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.05;
            color: var(--muted);
        }
        .grade-banner.pass .grade-value { color: var(--green); }
        .grade-banner.fail .grade-value { color: var(--red); }
        .grade-status { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); }
        .grade-banner.pass .grade-status { color: var(--green); }
        .grade-banner.fail .grade-status { color: var(--red); }
        .grade-right { text-align: right; min-width: 240px; }
        .grade-right .thresh { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .pts-label { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 7px; }
        .prog-track {
            height: 9px;
            background: #e3e7ef;
            border-radius: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 240px;
            margin-left: auto;
        }
        .prog-fill { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--muted); border-radius: 5px; transition: width 0.6s ease; }
        .prog-fill.pass { background: var(--green-light); }
        .prog-fill.fail { background: var(--red-light); }

        .autofail-banner {
            display: none;
            background: var(--red);
            color: white;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .autofail-banner.show { display: block; }

        /* SUMMARY STRIP */
        .summary-strip {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
            gap: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }
        .summary-item {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--navy);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 10px 12px;
        }
        .summary-item .k {
            font-size: 10px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.6px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }
        .summary-item .v { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; word-break: break-word; }

        /* SECTIONS + METRICS */
        .qa-section { margin-bottom: 18px; }
        .qa-section-header {
            background: var(--navy);
            color: white;
            padding: 11px 16px;
            border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .qa-section-header.zero { background: var(--red); }
        .qa-section-header .sec-pts {
            margin-left: auto;
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            opacity: 0.85;
        }
        .qa-rows {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-top: none;
            border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius) var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        .qa-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr 96px;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            align-items: start;
        }
        .qa-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .qa-row.passed { background: var(--pass-bg); }
        .qa-row.failed { background: var(--fail-bg); }
        .row-num {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            background: var(--navy-light);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 11.5px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 1px;
        }
        .qa-row.failed .row-num { background: var(--red); }
        .row-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px; }
        .row-criteria { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; }
        .row-obs {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            color: var(--text);
            margin-top: 7px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding-left: 10px;
            border-left: 2px solid var(--border);
        }
        .row-rec {
            font-size: 12.5px;
            color: #8a4b00;
            margin-top: 6px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            background: #fff8ec;
            border: 1px solid #f3dfc0;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 7px 9px;
        }
        .row-rec b { color: #a35b00; }
        .row-right { text-align: center; }
        .pts-chip {
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
        }
        .pts-chip .den { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
        .status-chip {
            display: inline-block;
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .status-chip.pass { background: var(--green-light); color: white; }
        .status-chip.partial { background: var(--gold); color: white; }
        .status-chip.fail, .status-chip.auto-fail { background: var(--red); color: white; }
        .status-chip.na, .status-chip.not-observed { background: #dde1e9; color: var(--muted); }

        /* COACHING */
        .feedback-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        .feedback-box {
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--card);
            padding: 15px 16px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        .feedback-box h4 {
            font-size: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.6px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 7px;
        }
        .feedback-box.strengths { border-top: 3px solid var(--green-light); }
        .feedback-box.strengths h4 { color: var(--green); }
        .feedback-box.opps { border-top: 3px solid var(--gold); }
        .feedback-box.opps h4 { color: #9a7200; }
        .feedback-box.concerns { border-top: 3px solid var(--red-light); }
        .feedback-box.concerns h4 { color: var(--red); }
        .feedback-box ul { list-style: none; }
        .feedback-box li {
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding: 5px 0 5px 18px;
            position: relative;
            border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border);
        }
        .feedback-box li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .feedback-box li::before { content: '•'; position: absolute; left: 4px; color: var(--muted); }
        .feedback-box .empty { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }

        .coach-card {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            padding: 18px 20px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }
        .coach-card h3 {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: var(--navy);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .action-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            background: #fbfcfd;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 9px;
        }
        .action-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
        .action-num {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            background: var(--navy);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 11.5px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .action-text { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
        .suggestion-item {
            background: #fbfcfd;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--red);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 9px;
        }
        .suggestion-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
        .suggestion-area {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.6px;
            color: var(--red);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
        }
        .suggestion-text { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
        .suggestion-example {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--navy);
            background: #eef2f9;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 8px 10px;
            margin-top: 8px;
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .suggestion-example::before { content: 'Say it like this: '; font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; }
        .coaching-notes {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 140px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 13px 14px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 13.5px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--text);
            background: #fbfcfd;
            resize: vertical;
        }

        details.transcript { margin-top: 4px; }
        details.transcript summary {
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--navy);
            padding: 10px 0;
            user-select: none;
        }
        .transcript-box {
            background: #fbfcfd;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 14px 16px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.65;
            color: var(--text);
            max-height: 300px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
        }

        .ai-note {
            font-size: 11.5px;
            color: var(--muted);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 16px;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        @media (max-width: 760px) {
            .meta-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
            .feedback-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .qa-row { grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr; }
            .row-right { grid-column: 2; text-align: left; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
            .status-chip { margin-top: 0; }
            .grade-right { text-align: left; }
            .prog-track { margin-left: 0; }
            .steps { flex-direction: column; }
        }

        @media print {
            body { background: white; }
            .header, .actions-row, #uploadSection, #infoSection, #progressSection,
            .fallback-link, .ai-note, .no-print { display: none !important; }
            .card, .qa-rows, .grade-banner, .coach-card, .feedback-box { box-shadow: none; }
            .qa-row { break-inside: avoid; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="header">
    <div>
        <div class="header-title">CSR Call Evaluator</div>
        <div class="header-sub">Upload · Transcribe · Score against QA Form</div>
    </div>
    <a class='home-link' href='/'>← Suite Home</a>
</div>

<div class="main">

    <div class="steps" id="stepsBar">
        <div class="step active" id="step1">1 · Upload Recording</div>
        <div class="step" id="step2">2 · Call Details</div>
        <div class="step" id="step3">3 · Evaluation & Coaching</div>
    </div>

    <div id="errorMessage" class="msg error"></div>
    <div id="successMessage" class="msg success"></div>

    <!-- STEP 1: UPLOAD -->
    <div class="card" id="uploadSection">
        <div class="card-label">Call Recording</div>
        <div class="dropzone" id="dropzone">
            <div class="dropzone-icon">🎙️</div>
            <div class="dropzone-title">Upload Call Recording</div>
            <div class="dropzone-sub">Click to select or drag an MP3 file here · max 3 MB (≈ 3-minute call)</div>
            <input type="file" id="audioInput" accept="audio/mpeg,audio/mp3,.mp3,audio/wav,audio/x-wav,audio/mp4,audio/m4a,.mp4,.m4a,.wav">
        </div>

        <div class="file-chip" id="fileChip">
            <div class="f-icon">🎵</div>
            <div class="f-meta">
                <div class="f-name" id="fileName"></div>
                <div class="f-sub" id="fileSub"></div>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="f-remove" id="fileRemove">Change</button>
        </div>

        <span class="fallback-link">No audio file? <a id="fallbackToggle">Paste the transcript instead</a></span>
        <div class="fallback-box" id="fallbackBox">
            <textarea id="manualTranscript" placeholder="Paste the call transcript here (agent and customer turns)..."></textarea>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- STEP 2: CALL DETAILS -->
    <div class="card" id="infoSection" style="display:none;">
        <div class="card-label">Call Information</div>
        <div class="meta-grid">
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="agentName">Agent Name *</label>
                <input type="text" id="agentName" placeholder="Enter full name">
            </div>
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="callDate">Call Date *</label>
                <input type="date" id="callDate">
            </div>
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="customerName">Customer Name</label>
                <input type="text" id="customerName" placeholder="Customer full name">
            </div>
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="customerPhone">Customer Phone #</label>
                <input type="text" id="customerPhone" placeholder="(555) 000-0000">
            </div>
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="dealership">Dealership Name</label>
                <input type="text" id="dealership" placeholder="Dealership">
            </div>
            <div class="meta-field">
                <label for="disposition">Call Disposition</label>
                <input type="text" id="disposition" placeholder="e.g. Warm Transfer – Service">
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="actions-row" style="margin-top:18px;">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="backToUpload" type="button">← Back</button>
            <button class="btn btn-red" id="analyzeBtn" type="button">🎯 Analyze Call & Generate Score</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PROGRESS -->
    <div class="card" id="progressSection">
        <div class="spinner"></div>
        <div class="progress-stage" id="progressStage">Transcribing call recording…</div>
        <div class="progress-hint" id="progressHint">Sending audio securely to the speech-to-text service</div>
        <div class="progress-track"><div class="progress-fill" id="progressFill"></div></div>
    </div>

    <!-- RESULTS -->
    <div id="resultsSection">
        <div id="reportArea">

            <div class="grade-banner" id="gradeBanner">
                <div>
                    <div class="grade-label">Final Grade</div>
                    <div class="grade-value" id="gradeValue">—%</div>
                    <div class="grade-status" id="gradeStatus"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="grade-right">
                    <div class="thresh">Passing threshold: 85%</div>
                    <div class="prog-track"><div class="prog-fill" id="progFill"></div></div>
                    <div class="pts-label" id="ptsLabel">0 / 100 pts scored</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="autofail-banner" id="autofailBanner">
                ⚠ AUTO FAIL TRIGGERED — Zero-tolerance behavior observed. Grade is 0% and this call requires PIP enrollment review.
            </div>

            <div class="summary-strip" id="summaryStrip"></div>

            <!-- Scored sections rendered here -->
            <div id="sectionsContainer"></div>

            <!-- Feedback -->
            <div class="feedback-grid" style="margin-top:18px;">
                <div class="feedback-box strengths">
                    <h4>✓ Strengths Observed</h4>
                    <ul id="strengthsList"></ul>
                </div>
                <div class="feedback-box opps">
                    <h4>→ Areas for Development</h4>
                    <ul id="oppsList"></ul>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="feedback-box concerns" id="concernsBox" style="margin-top:14px; display:none;">
                <h4>⚠ Concerns</h4>
                <ul id="concernsList"></ul>
            </div>

            <!-- Coaching -->
            <div class="coach-card" style="margin-top:18px;">
                <h3>🧭 Coaching Plan — How to Make This Call Better</h3>
                <div id="suggestionsContainer"></div>
                <div id="actionsContainer" style="margin-top:14px;"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="coach-card">
                <h3>📝 Detailed Coaching Notes</h3>
                <textarea class="coaching-notes" id="coachingNotes" readonly></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="coach-card">
                <details class="transcript">
                    <summary>📜 View Full Call Transcript</summary>
                    <div class="transcript-box" id="transcriptBox"></div>
                </details>
            </div>

            <p class="ai-note">AI-generated evaluation — always verify against the recording before making coaching or HR decisions.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="actions-row" style="margin-top:18px;">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="resetBtn" type="button">🔄 Analyze Another Call</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" id="pdfBtn" type="button">📥 Download Report (PDF)</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    'use strict';

    /* ---------------- QA form definition (mirrors the interactive form) ------------- */
    const MAX_BYTES = 3 * 1024 * 1024; // keep in sync with netlify/functions/transcribe.js
    const PASSING_THRESHOLD = 85;

    const RUBRIC = {
        1:  { sec: 1, pts: 10, title: 'Proper Branding',                 criteria: 'Announced the dealership name' },
        2:  { sec: 1, pts: 10, title: 'Agent Introduction',              criteria: 'Introduced themselves by name' },
        3:  { sec: 2, pts: 8,  title: 'Reason for Transfer',             criteria: 'Asked the customer the reason for the transfer' },
        4:  { sec: 2, pts: 8,  title: 'Customer Name',                   criteria: "Asked for the customer's name to address them properly" },
        5:  { sec: 2, pts: 8,  title: 'Department Introduction',         criteria: 'Introduced the customer to Service/Parts before transferring' },
        6:  { sec: 3, pts: 8,  title: 'Warm Transfer Protocol',          criteria: 'Hold 3 rings — wait for someone to answer before releasing', hot: true },
        7:  { sec: 3, pts: 5,  title: 'Data Entry Accuracy',             criteria: 'First and last name + phone number entered accurately' },
        8:  { sec: 3, pts: 8,  title: 'Call Disposition',                criteria: 'Correct call disposition selected in the system' },
        9:  { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Hold Procedure',                  criteria: 'Set expectation before placing on hold; explained reason for silence' },
        10: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Communication & Delivery',        criteria: 'Enunciates clearly; avoids jargon; speaks with fluidity' },
        11: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Empathy',                         criteria: "Acknowledged customer's emotion appropriately" },
        12: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Active Listening',                criteria: 'Avoided repetition; showed attention to detail' },
        13: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Tone of Voice',                   criteria: 'Sounded accommodating and willing to help' },
        14: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Efficiency',                      criteria: "Was concise in delivering resolution to customer's concern" },
        15: { sec: 4, pts: 5,  title: 'Confidence',                      criteria: 'Sounded certain and accurate; assured the customer' },
        16: { sec: 5, pts: 0,  title: 'Rudeness',                        criteria: 'Used profanity or condescending statement; condescending tone; consistently interrupted customer', zero: true },
        17: { sec: 5, pts: 0,  title: 'Service Fail',                    criteria: 'Booked when policy says Do Not Book (or vice versa); incorrect appt date/time; failure to confirm transportation option; or no appointment scheduled', zero: true },
        18: { sec: 5, pts: 0,  title: 'Call Avoidance',                  criteria: 'Disconnecting calls intentionally', zero: true }
    };

    const SECTIONS = [
        { id: 1, name: '1 — Call Flow Procedure',        possible: 20 },
        { id: 2, name: '2 — Body of the Call',           possible: 24 },
        { id: 3, name: '3 — System Process Accuracy',    possible: 21 },
        { id: 4, name: '4 — Call Management Skills',     possible: 35 },
        { id: 5, name: '5 — Zero Tolerance Behavior',    possible: 0, zero: true }
    ];

    const STATUS_LABELS = {
        'pass': 'Pass',
        'partial': 'Partial',
        'fail': 'Fail',
        'na': 'N/A',
        'not-observed': 'Not Observed',
        'auto-fail': 'Auto Fail'
    };

    /* ---------------- state ---------------- */
    let audioFile = null;
    let analysisResults = null;
    let currentTranscript = '';

    /* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    function esc(s) {
        return String(s == null ? '' : s)
            .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
    }

    function fmtBytes(n) {
        if (n < 1024) return n + ' B';
        if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(0) + ' KB';
        return (n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
    }

    function fmtDuration(sec) {
        if (!isFinite(sec) || sec <= 0) return '';
        const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
        const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
        return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    function showError(msg) {
        const el = $('errorMessage');
        el.textContent = msg;
        el.classList.add('show');
        $('successMessage').classList.remove('show');
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function showSuccess(msg) {
        const el = $('successMessage');
        el.textContent = msg;
        el.classList.add('show');
        $('errorMessage').classList.remove('show');
    }

    function clearMessages() {
        $('errorMessage').classList.remove('show');
        $('successMessage').classList.remove('show');
    }

    function setStep(n) {
        [1, 2, 3].forEach((i) => {
            const el = $('step' + i);
            el.classList.toggle('active', i === n);
            el.classList.toggle('done', i < n);
        });
    }

    /* ---------------- upload ---------------- */
    const dropzone = $('dropzone');
    const audioInput = $('audioInput');

    dropzone.addEventListener('click', () => audioInput.click());
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); dropzone.classList.add('dragover'); });
    dropzone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropzone.classList.remove('dragover'));
    dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        dropzone.classList.remove('dragover');
        if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    });
    audioInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) handleFile(e.target.files[0]);
    });

    function handleFile(file) {
        clearMessages();
        const okTypes = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp3', 'audio/wav', 'audio/x-wav', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/m4a'];
        const okExt = /\.(mp3|wav|m4a|mp4)$/i.test(file.name);
        if (!okTypes.includes(file.type) && !okExt) {
            showError('Please upload an audio file (MP3 format recommended).');
            return;
        }
        if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
            showError('File is ' + fmtBytes(file.size) + ' — please use a clip under ' +
                fmtBytes(MAX_BYTES) + ' (roughly a 3-minute call at typical MP3 quality).');
            return;
        }

        audioFile = file;
        $('fileName').textContent = file.name;
        $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size) + ' · loading duration…';
        $('fileChip').classList.add('show');
        dropzone.style.display = 'none';
        showSuccess('✓ File loaded: ' + file.name);

        // Read duration for the chip (best effort).
        try {
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            const probe = new Audio();
            probe.preload = 'metadata';
            probe.onloadedmetadata = () => {
                const d = fmtDuration(probe.duration);
                $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size) + (d ? ' · ' + d : '');
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            };
            probe.onerror = () => { $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
            probe.src = url;
        } catch (err) { /* duration is cosmetic only */ }

        setTimeout(() => {
            $('uploadSection').style.display = 'none';
            $('infoSection').style.display = 'block';
            $('callDate').valueAsDate = new Date();
            setStep(2);
        }, 600);
    }

    $('fileRemove').addEventListener('click', () => resetToUpload(true));

    $('backToUpload').addEventListener('click', () => resetToUpload(false));

    function resetToUpload(clearFile) {
        clearMessages();
        if (clearFile) {
            audioFile = null;
            audioInput.value = '';
            $('fileChip').classList.remove('show');
            dropzone.style.display = 'block';
        }
        $('infoSection').style.display = 'none';
        $('uploadSection').style.display = 'block';
        setStep(1);
    }

    /* ---------------- transcript fallback toggle ---------------- */
    $('fallbackToggle').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const box = $('fallbackBox');
        box.classList.toggle('show');
        if (box.classList.contains('show')) {
            dropzone.style.display = 'none';
            $('manualTranscript').focus();
        } else if (!audioFile) {
            dropzone.style.display = 'block';
        }
    });

    /* ---------------- analysis pipeline ---------------- */
    function fileToBase64(file) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result.split(',')[1]);
            reader.onerror = reject;
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
    }

    function setProgress(stage, hint, pct) {
        $('progressStage').textContent = stage;
        $('progressHint').textContent = hint;
        $('progressFill').style.width = pct + '%';
    }

    async function postJSON(url, body) {
        let response;
        try {
            response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(body)
            });
        } catch (err) {
            throw new Error('Network error reaching ' + url + ' — check your connection and that the site is deployed on Netlify (functions are unavailable on plain file opens or drag-and-drop deploys).');
        }
        let data = null;
        try { data = await response.json(); } catch (err) { /* non-JSON response */ }
        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error((data && data.error) || ('Request to ' + url + ' failed (HTTP ' + response.status + ')'));
        }
        if (!data) throw new Error('Empty response from ' + url);
        return data;
    }

    async function analyzeCall() {
        clearMessages();

        const agentName = $('agentName').value.trim();
        const callDate = $('callDate').value;
        $('agentName').classList.toggle('required-missing', !agentName);
        $('callDate').classList.toggle('required-missing', !callDate);

        const manualText = $('manualTranscript').value.trim();

        if (!audioFile && !manualText) {
            showError('Please upload an MP3 recording or paste a transcript.');
            return;
        }
        if (!agentName) { showError('Please enter the agent name.'); return; }
        if (!callDate) { showError('Please enter the call date.'); return; }

        $('analyzeBtn').disabled = true;
        $('infoSection').style.display = 'none';
        $('progressSection').style.display = 'block';
        setStep(3);

        let stage = manualText ? 'analyze' : 'transcribe';

        try {
            let transcript = manualText;

            if (!transcript) {
                setProgress('Transcribing call recording…',
                    'Sending audio securely to the speech-to-text service', 35);
                const base64Audio = await fileToBase64(audioFile);
                const data = await postJSON('/api/transcribe', {
                    audio: base64Audio,
                    mimeType: audioFile.type || 'audio/mpeg'
                });
                transcript = (data.transcript || '').trim();
                if (!transcript) throw new Error('No speech was detected in this file.');
            }

            stage = 'analyze';
            setProgress('Scoring against the QA form…',
                'Evaluating all 18 metrics across 5 sections and writing coaching feedback', 75);
            const result = await postJSON('/api/analyze', {
                transcript: transcript,
                agentName: agentName,
                callDate: callDate
            });

            if (!result.analysis) throw new Error('Analysis returned no results.');

            analysisResults = normalizeResult(result.analysis);
            currentTranscript = transcript;
            setProgress('Done', '', 100);
            renderResults();

        } catch (error) {
            $('progressSection').style.display = 'none';
            $('infoSection').style.display = 'block';
            setStep(2);
            const stepLabel = stage === 'transcribe'
                ? 'Step 1 (transcription / Deepgram) failed: '
                : 'Step 2 (scoring) failed: ';
            const keyName = stage === 'transcribe'
                ? 'DEEPGRAM_API_KEY'
                : 'GEMINI_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY';
            const msg = error.message || String(error);
            let hint = '';
            if (/not set|no scoring ai key/i.test(msg)) {
                hint = stage === 'transcribe'
                    ? ' Add DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in Netlify (Site configuration → Environment variables), then trigger a redeploy — env changes only apply to new deploys.'
                    : ' Free fix (no credit card): get a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey (Gemini) or console.groq.com/keys (Groq), add it as GEMINI_API_KEY or GROQ_API_KEY in Netlify (Site configuration → Environment variables), then redeploy.';
            } else if (stage === 'transcribe' && /credential/i.test(msg)) {
                hint = ' The transcription service rejected the key — create a fresh one at console.deepgram.com (Settings → API Keys), replace DEEPGRAM_API_KEY in Netlify, and redeploy.';
            } else if (/api.?key|credential/i.test(msg)) {
                hint = ' Check your key in Netlify (Site configuration → Environment variables) — expected ' + keyName + ' — then redeploy.';
            } else if (/Network error|HTTP 404|HTTP 502/i.test(msg)) {
                hint = ' If this site was deployed by drag-and-drop, redeploy from the GitHub repo so the Netlify functions are bundled (see FUNCTIONS_SETUP.md).';
            }
            showError('Error analyzing call: ' + stepLabel + msg + hint);
        } finally {
            $('analyzeBtn').disabled = false;
        }
    }

    $('analyzeBtn').addEventListener('click', analyzeCall);

    /* ------------- client-side scoring: QA form arithmetic (authoritative) -------------
       Works with both the upgraded analyze.js response and the older flat response. */
    function normalizeResult(raw) {
        const rawMetrics = Array.isArray(raw.metrics) ? raw.metrics : [];
        const byId = {};
        rawMetrics.forEach((m, i) => {
            const id = m && m.id != null ? Number(m.id) : i + 1;
            if (id >= 1 && id <= 18 && byId[id] === undefined) byId[id] = m;
        });

        const rows = [];
        const secEarned = { 1: 0, 2: 0, 3: 0, 4: 0 };
        const autoFailItems = [];

        for (let id = 1; id <= 18; id++) {
            const rubric = RUBRIC[id];
            const m = byId[id] || {};
            const statusRaw = String(m.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            let status, earned;

            if (id >= 16) {
                const fail = ['auto-fail', 'auto_fail', 'autofail', 'fail', 'triggered', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw);
                status = fail ? 'auto-fail' : 'not-observed';
                earned = 0;
                if (fail) autoFailItems.push(id);
            } else if (id <= 8) {
                if (['pass', 'yes', 'full', 'full points'].includes(statusRaw)) {
                    status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts;
                } else if (statusRaw) {
                    status = (statusRaw === 'na' || statusRaw === 'n/a') ? 'na' : 'fail';
                    earned = 0;
                } else {
                    const n = Number(m.score_earned);
                    earned = isFinite(n) ? Math.min(rubric.pts, Math.max(0, Math.round(n))) : 0;
                    status = earned >= rubric.pts ? 'pass' : earned > 0 ? 'partial' : 'fail';
                }
            } else if (id === 9) {
                if (['pass', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts; }
                else if (['na', 'n/a'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'na'; earned = 0; }
                else { status = 'fail'; earned = 0; }
            } else {
                if (['pass', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts; }
                else if (['partial', 'partially'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'partial'; earned = 3; }
                else { status = 'fail'; earned = 0; }
            }

            rows.push({
                id,
                sec: rubric.sec,
                title: rubric.title,
                criteria: rubric.criteria,
                possible: rubric.pts,
                zero: !!rubric.zero,
                status,
                earned,
                observation: typeof m.observation === 'string' ? m.observation.trim() : '',
                recommendation: typeof m.recommendation === 'string' ? m.recommendation.trim() : ''
            });

            if (rubric.sec <= 4) secEarned[rubric.sec] += earned;
        }

        const total = rows.filter((r) => r.id <= 15).reduce((s, r) => s + r.earned, 0);
        const autoFail = autoFailItems.length > 0;
        const grade = autoFail ? 0 : total;

        const strArr = (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x) => typeof x === 'string' && x.trim()) : []);

        return {
            grade,
            total,
            passed: !autoFail && grade >= PASSING_THRESHOLD,
            autoFail,
            autoFailItems,
            rows,
            sections: SECTIONS.map((s) => ({
                ...s,
                earned: s.zero ? 0 : secEarned[s.id]
            })),
            reasonForCall: typeof raw.reason_for_call === 'string' ? raw.reason_for_call.trim() : '',
            strengths: strArr(raw.strengths),
            opportunities: strArr(raw.opportunities),
            concerns: strArr(raw.concerns),
            recommendedActions: strArr(raw.recommended_actions),
            coachingSuggestions: Array.isArray(raw.coaching_suggestions)
                ? raw.coaching_suggestions
                    .filter((s) => s && typeof s === 'object')
                    .map((s) => ({
                        area: String(s.area || '').trim(),
                        suggestion: String(s.suggestion || '').trim(),
                        example: String(s.example || '').trim()
                    }))
                    .filter((s) => s.suggestion)
                : [],
            coachingNotes: typeof raw.coaching_notes === 'string' ? raw.coaching_notes.trim() : ''
        };
    }

    /* ---------------- rendering ---------------- */
    function renderResults() {
        const r = analysisResults;
        $('progressSection').style.display = 'none';
        $('resultsSection').style.display = 'block';

        // Grade banner
        const banner = $('gradeBanner');
        banner.classList.remove('pass', 'fail');
        banner.classList.add(r.passed ? 'pass' : 'fail');
        $('gradeValue').textContent = r.grade + '%';
        $('ptsLabel').textContent = r.total + ' / 100 pts scored';
        const fill = $('progFill');
        fill.classList.remove('pass', 'fail');
        fill.classList.add(r.passed ? 'pass' : 'fail');
        fill.style.width = r.grade + '%';

        let statusText;
        if (r.autoFail) statusText = '⚠ Auto Fail — PIP enrollment required';
        else if (r.passed) statusText = '✓ Passing — meets the 85% standard';
        else if (r.grade >= 70) statusText = 'Below passing — coaching required';
        else statusText = 'Needs improvement — coaching required';
        $('gradeStatus').textContent = statusText;

        $('autofailBanner').classList.toggle('show', r.autoFail);

        // Summary strip
        const summary = $('summaryStrip');
        const meta = [
            ['Reason for Call', r.reasonForCall || '—'],
            ['Agent', $('agentName').value.trim() || '—'],
            ['Call Date', $('callDate').value || '—'],
            ['Customer', $('customerName').value.trim() || '—'],
            ['Dealership', $('dealership').value.trim() || '—'],
            ['Disposition', $('disposition').value.trim() || '—']
        ];

<html lang="en">
<head>

    <style>

            --navy: #1a2a4a;
            --navy-light: #243355;
            --red: #c0392b;
            --red-light: #e74c3c;
            --green: #1e7e4a;
            --green-light: #27ae60;
            --gold: #d4a017;
            --bg: #f4f5f7;
            --card: #ffffff;
            --border: #dde1e9;
            --text: #1c2333;
            --muted: #5a6478;
            --pass-bg: #eafaf1;
            --fail-bg: #fdf0ee;
            --radius: 10px;
            --shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.08);
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* HEADER */
        .header {
            background: var(--navy);
            padding: 18px 32px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            border-bottom: 3px solid var(--red);
            gap: 16px;
        }
        .header-title { color: white; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
        .header-sub {
            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 400;
            opacity: 0.7;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .header-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .home-link {
            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
            text-decoration: none;
            opacity: 0.8;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
            padding: 7px 14px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.15s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .home-link:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); opacity: 1; }

        .main { max-width: 920px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 20px 70px; }

        .card {
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            padding: 22px 24px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .card-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            color: var(--muted);
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        /* STEPS */
        .steps { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 12px; }
        .step {
            flex: 1;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 9px 6px;
            border-radius: 7px;
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--muted);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .step.active { background: var(--navy); border-color: var(--navy); color: white; }
        .step.done { background: var(--pass-bg); border-color: #a9dfbf; color: var(--green); }

        /* UPLOAD */
        .dropzone {
            border: 2px dashed var(--navy);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            background: #fbfcfd;
            padding: 34px 20px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
        }

        .dropzone-icon { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .dropzone-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .dropzone-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
        #audioInput { display: none; }

            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;

            border: 1px solid #a9dfbf;

            padding: 14px 16px;

        .file-chip .f-meta { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .file-chip .f-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            white-space: nowrap;

        .file-chip .f-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
        .file-chip .f-remove {
            background: white;
            border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 7px 14px;
            font-size: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: inherit;
            color: var(--muted);
        }
        .file-chip .f-remove:hover { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }

        .fallback-link { display: block; text-align: center; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12.5px; }
        .fallback-link a { color: var(--navy); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }
        .fallback-box { display: none; margin-top: 14px; }
        .fallback-box.show { display: block; }
        .fallback-box textarea {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 130px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 7px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            resize: vertical;
            outline: none;
        }
        .fallback-box textarea:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }

        .meta-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }

            margin-bottom: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .meta-field input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 9px 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text);
            background: #fbfcfd;
            outline: none;
            transition: border-color 0.15s;
        }
        .meta-field input:focus { border-color: var(--navy); }
        .meta-field input.required-missing { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--fail-bg); }

        /* BUTTONS */
        .btn {
            padding: 12px 26px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 7px;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s;
        }
        .btn-primary { background: var(--navy); color: white; }
        .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }
        .btn-primary:disabled { background: #9aa4b8; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .btn-red { background: var(--red); color: white; }
        .btn-red:hover { background: var(--red-light); }
        .btn-red:disabled { background: #9aa4b8; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .btn-ghost { background: white; color: var(--navy); border: 1.5px solid var(--border); }
        .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--navy); }
        .actions-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-top: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        /* MESSAGES */
        .msg {
            display: none;
            padding: 13px 16px;

        .msg.success { background: var(--pass-bg); border: 1px solid #a9dfbf; color: #14532d; }

        /* PROGRESS */
        #progressSection { display: none; text-align: center; padding: 40px 24px; }

</head>
<body>

<div class="header">
    <div>
        <div class="header-title">CSR Call Evaluator</div>
        <div class="header-sub">Upload · Transcribe · Score against QA Form</div>
    </div>
    <div class="header-actions">

</div>

<div class="main">

    <div class="steps" id="stepsBar">

    <div id="errorMessage" class="msg error"></div>

</div>

<!-- API KEY MODAL -->
<div class="modal-backdrop" id="keyModal">

</div>

/* =====================================================================
   Configuration

function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
        .replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, ''');
}

function fmtBytes(n) {
    if (n < 1024) return n + ' B';
    if (n < 1024 * 1024) return (n / 1024).toFixed(0) + ' KB';
    return (n / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
}

function fmtDuration(sec) {
    if (!isFinite(sec) || sec <= 0) return '';
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
    return m + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
}

function handleFile(file) {
    clearMessages();
    const okTypes = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp3', 'audio/wav', 'audio/x-wav', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/m4a'];
    const okExt = /\.(mp3|wav|m4a|mp4)$/i.test(file.name);
    if (!okTypes.includes(file.type) && !okExt) {
        showError('Please upload an audio file (MP3 format recommended).');
        return;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
        showError('File is ' + fmtBytes(file.size) + ' — please use a file under ' + fmtBytes(MAX_BYTES) + '.');
        return;
    }

    audioFile = file;
    $('fileName').textContent = file.name;
    $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size) + ' · loading duration…';
    $('fileChip').classList.add('show');
    dropzone.style.display = 'none';
    showSuccess('✓ File loaded: ' + file.name);

    try {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const probe = new Audio();
        probe.preload = 'metadata';
        probe.onloadedmetadata = () => {
            const d = fmtDuration(probe.duration);
            $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size) + (d ? ' · ' + d : '');
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        };
        probe.onerror = () => { $('fileSub').textContent = fmtBytes(file.size); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
        probe.src = url;
    } catch (err) { /* duration is cosmetic only */ }

    setTimeout(() => {
        $('uploadSection').style.display = 'none';
        $('infoSection').style.display = 'block';
        $('callDate').valueAsDate = new Date();
        setStep(2);
    }, 600);
}

}

async function groqTranscribe(file, apiKey) {
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', file, file.name);
    form.append('model', 'whisper-large-v3');
    form.append('response_format', 'json');

    let res;
    try {
        res = await fetch(TRANSCRIBE_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + apiKey },
            body: form
        });
    } catch (e) {
        throw new Error('Network error reaching the transcription service — check your connection.');
    }

    let data = null;
    try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) { /* non-JSON */ }
    if (!res.ok) {
        const m = data && data.error && data.error.message ? data.error.message : ('HTTP ' + res.status);
        if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
            throw new Error('Transcription rejected the API key (' + m + '). Open ⚙ API Key and paste a valid key from console.groq.com/keys.');
        }
        if (res.status === 413 || /too large|maximum file size/i.test(m)) {
            throw new Error('Audio file is too large for the transcription service (' + m + '). Use a shorter clip.');
        }
        throw new Error('Transcription failed: ' + m);
    }
    const text = data && data.text ? String(data.text).trim() : '';
    if (!text) throw new Error('No speech was detected in this file.');
    return text;
}

async function groqScore(transcript, agentName, callDate, apiKey) {
    const messages = [
        {
            role: 'system',
            content: 'You are a meticulous QA scoring engine. You output valid JSON only, never markdown or prose.'
        },
        { role: 'user', content: buildScoringPrompt(transcript, agentName, callDate) }
    ];

    let lastErr = null;
    for (const model of CHAT_MODELS) {
        let res;
        try {
            res = await fetch(CHAT_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + apiKey,
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    model: model,
                    messages: messages,
                    temperature: 0.2,
                    max_tokens: 4000,
                    response_format: { type: 'json_object' }
                })
            });
        } catch (e) {
            throw new Error('Network error reaching the scoring service — check your connection.');
        }

        let data = null;
        try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) { /* non-JSON */ }

        if (res.ok && data && data.choices && data.choices[0] && data.choices[0].message) {
            const raw = data.choices[0].message.content || '';
            const parsed = tryParseJSON(raw);
            if (parsed) return parsed;
            lastErr = new Error('The scoring service returned malformed JSON — please run the analysis again.');
            continue;
        }

        const m = data && data.error && data.error.message ? data.error.message : ('HTTP ' + res.status);
        if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
            throw new Error('Scoring rejected the API key (' + m + '). Open ⚙ API Key and paste a valid key from console.groq.com/keys.');
        }
        if (/decommissioned|model_not_found|does not exist|invalid model/i.test(m)) {
            lastErr = new Error('Scoring model unavailable: ' + m);
            continue; // try the next model in CHAT_MODELS
        }
        throw new Error('Scoring failed: ' + m);
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error('Scoring failed — no available model.');
}

function tryParseJSON(text) {
    if (!text) return null;
    let t = text.trim();
    if (t.startsWith('```')) {
        t = t.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/, '');
    }
    try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { /* fall through */ }
    const s = t.indexOf('{');
    const eIdx = t.lastIndexOf('}');
    if (s !== -1 && eIdx > s) {
        try { return JSON.parse(t.slice(s, eIdx + 1)); } catch (err) { /* give up */ }
    }
    return null;
}

    if (!agentName) { showError('Please enter the agent name.'); return; }
    if (!callDate) { showError('Please enter the call date.'); return; }
    if (!apiKey) {
        showError('No API key saved. Click ⚙ API Key in the header and paste a free Groq key from console.groq.com/keys.');
        $('keyModal').classList.add('show');
        return;
    }

    $('analyzeBtn').disabled = true;

            setProgress('Transcribing call recording…',
                'Sending audio securely to the speech-to-text service', 35);
            transcript = await groqTranscribe(audioFile, apiKey);
        }

        stage = 'analyze';
        setProgress('Scoring against the QA form…',
            'Evaluating all 18 metrics across 5 sections and writing coaching feedback', 75);
        const analysis = await groqScore(transcript, agentName, callDate, apiKey);

        if (!analysis) throw new Error('Analysis returned no results.');

        analysisResults = normalizeResult(analysis);
        currentTranscript = transcript;
        setProgress('Done', '', 100);

        $('progressSection').style.display = 'none';
        $('infoSection').style.display = 'block';

    } finally {
        $('analyzeBtn').disabled = false;
    }
}

/* =====================================================================
   Client-side scoring arithmetic (authoritative — LLM only supplies statuses)
   ===================================================================== */
function normalizeResult(raw) {
    const rawMetrics = Array.isArray(raw.metrics) ? raw.metrics : [];
    const byId = {};
    rawMetrics.forEach((m, i) => {
        const id = m && m.id != null ? Number(m.id) : i + 1;
        if (id >= 1 && id <= 18 && byId[id] === undefined) byId[id] = m;
    });

    const rows = [];
    const secEarned = { 1: 0, 2: 0, 3: 0, 4: 0 };
    const autoFailItems = [];

    for (let id = 1; id <= 18; id++) {
        const rubric = RUBRIC[id];
        const m = byId[id] || {};
        const statusRaw = String(m.status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        let status, earned;

        if (id >= 16) {
            const fail = ['auto-fail', 'auto_fail', 'autofail', 'fail', 'triggered', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw);
            status = fail ? 'auto-fail' : 'not-observed';
            earned = 0;
            if (fail) autoFailItems.push(id);
        } else if (id <= 8) {
            if (['pass', 'yes', 'full', 'full points'].includes(statusRaw)) {
                status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts;
            } else if (statusRaw) {
                status = (statusRaw === 'na' || statusRaw === 'n/a') ? 'na' : 'fail';
                earned = 0;
            } else {
                const n = Number(m.score_earned);
                earned = isFinite(n) ? Math.min(rubric.pts, Math.max(0, Math.round(n))) : 0;
                status = earned >= rubric.pts ? 'pass' : earned > 0 ? 'partial' : 'fail';
            }
        } else if (id === 9) {
            if (['pass', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts; }
            else if (['na', 'n/a'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'na'; earned = 0; }
            else { status = 'fail'; earned = 0; }
        } else {
            if (['pass', 'yes'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'pass'; earned = rubric.pts; }
            else if (['partial', 'partially'].includes(statusRaw)) { status = 'partial'; earned = 3; }
            else { status = 'fail'; earned = 0; }
        }

        rows.push({
            id,
            sec: rubric.sec,
            title: rubric.title,
            criteria: rubric.criteria,
            possible: rubric.pts,
            zero: !!rubric.zero,
            status,
            earned,
            observation: typeof m.observation === 'string' ? m.observation.trim() : '',
            recommendation: typeof m.recommendation === 'string' ? m.recommendation.trim() : ''
        });

        if (rubric.sec <= 4) secEarned[rubric.sec] += earned;
    }

    const total = rows.filter((r) => r.id <= 15).reduce((s, r) => s + r.earned, 0);
    const autoFail = autoFailItems.length > 0;
    const grade = autoFail ? 0 : total;

    const strArr = (v) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x) => typeof x === 'string' && x.trim()) : []);

    return {
        grade,
        total,
        passed: !autoFail && grade >= PASSING_THRESHOLD,
        autoFail,
        autoFailItems,
        rows,
        sections: SECTIONS.map((s) => ({ ...s, earned: s.zero ? 0 : secEarned[s.id] })),
        reasonForCall: typeof raw.reason_for_call === 'string' ? raw.reason_for_call.trim() : '',
        strengths: strArr(raw.strengths),
        opportunities: strArr(raw.opportunities),
        concerns: strArr(raw.concerns),
        recommendedActions: strArr(raw.recommended_actions),
        coachingSuggestions: Array.isArray(raw.coaching_suggestions)
            ? raw.coaching_suggestions
                .filter((s) => s && typeof s === 'object')
                .map((s) => ({
                    area: String(s.area || '').trim(),
                    suggestion: String(s.suggestion || '').trim(),
                    example: String(s.example || '').trim()
                }))
                .filter((s) => s.suggestion)
            : [],
        coachingNotes: typeof raw.coaching_notes === 'string' ? raw.coaching_notes.trim() : ''
    };
}

function renderResults() {
    const r = analysisResults;
    $('progressSection').style.display = 'none';
    $('resultsSection').style.display = 'block';

    // Grade banner
    const banner = $('gradeBanner');
    banner.classList.remove('pass', 'fail');
    banner.classList.add(r.passed ? 'pass' : 'fail');
    $('gradeValue').textContent = r.grade + '%';
    $('ptsLabel').textContent = r.total + ' / 100 pts scored';
    const fill = $('progFill');
    fill.classList.remove('pass', 'fail');
    fill.classList.add(r.passed ? 'pass' : 'fail');
    fill.style.width = r.grade + '%';

    let statusText;
    if (r.autoFail) statusText = '⚠ Auto Fail — PIP enrollment required';
    else if (r.passed) statusText = '✓ Passing — meets the 85% standard';
    else if (r.grade >= 70) statusText = 'Below passing — coaching required';
    else statusText = 'Needs improvement — coaching required';
    $('gradeStatus').textContent = statusText;

    $('autofailBanner').classList.toggle('show', r.autoFail);

    // Summary strip
    const meta = [
        ['Reason for Call', r.reasonForCall || '—'],
        ['Agent', $('agentName').value.trim() || '—'],
        ['Call Date', $('callDate').value || '—'],
        ['Customer', $('customerName').value.trim() || '—'],
        ['Dealership', $('dealership').value.trim() || '—'],
        ['Disposition', $('disposition').value.trim() || '—']
    ];
    $('summaryStrip').innerHTML = meta.map(([k, v]) =>
        '<div class="summary-item"><div class="k">' + esc(k) + '</div><div class="v">' + esc(v) + '</div></div>'
    ).join('');

    // Sections + metric rows
    $('sectionsContainer').innerHTML = r.sections.map((sec) => {
        const secRows = r.rows.filter((row) => row.sec === sec.id);
        const rowsHTML = secRows.map((row, i) => {
            const cls = row.zero
                ? (row.status === 'auto-fail' ? 'failed' : '')
                : (row.status === 'pass' ? 'passed' : (row.status === 'fail' ? 'failed' : ''));
            const ptsText = row.zero
                ? '—'
                : '<span class="pts-chip">' + row.earned + '<span class="den"> / ' + row.possible + '</span></span>';
            const statusHTML = '<span class="status-chip ' + esc(row.status) + '">' +
                esc(STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status) + '</span>';
            const obsHTML = row.observation
                ? '<div class="row-obs">' + esc(row.observation) + '</div>' : '';
            const recHTML = row.recommendation
                ? '<div class="row-rec"><b>Coaching:</b> ' + esc(row.recommendation) + '</div>' : '';

            return '<div class="qa-row ' + cls + '">' +
                '<div class="row-num">' + (i + 1) + '</div>' +
                '<div>' +
                    '<div class="row-title">' + esc(row.title) + '</div>' +
                    '<div class="row-criteria">' + esc(row.criteria) + '</div>' +
                    obsHTML + recHTML +
                '</div>' +
                '<div class="row-right">' + ptsText + '<br>' + statusHTML + '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }).join('');

        const ptsLabel = sec.zero ? 'Zero Tolerance' : sec.earned + ' / ' + sec.possible + ' pts';
        return '<div class="qa-section">' +
            '<div class="qa-section-header' + (sec.zero ? ' zero' : '') + '">' +
                esc(sec.name) + '<span class="sec-pts">' + esc(ptsLabel) + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="qa-rows">' + rowsHTML + '</div>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');

    // Feedback
    fillList($('strengthsList'), r.strengths, 'No specific strengths noted.');
    fillList($('oppsList'), r.opportunities, 'No development areas noted.');
    const concernsBox = $('concernsBox');
    if (r.concerns.length) {
        fillList($('concernsList'), r.concerns, '');
        concernsBox.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        concernsBox.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Coaching suggestions
    $('suggestionsContainer').innerHTML = r.coachingSuggestions.length
        ? r.coachingSuggestions.map((s) =>
            '<div class="suggestion-item">' +
                (s.area ? '<div class="suggestion-area">' + esc(s.area) + '</div>' : '') +
                '<div class="suggestion-text">' + esc(s.suggestion) + '</div>' +
                (s.example ? '<div class="suggestion-example">' + esc(s.example) + '</div>' : '') +
            '</div>'
        ).join('')
        : '<p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;">No specific suggestions generated.</p>';

    // Recommended actions
    $('actionsContainer').innerHTML = r.recommendedActions.length
        ? r.recommendedActions.map((a, i) =>
            '<div class="action-item">' +
                '<div class="action-num">' + (i + 1) + '</div>' +
                '<div class="action-text">' + esc(a) + '</div>' +
            '</div>'
        ).join('')
        : '';

    // Coaching notes + transcript
    $('coachingNotes').value = r.coachingNotes || 'No coaching notes generated.';
    $('transcriptBox').textContent = currentTranscript || '—';

    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

/* =====================================================================
   Reset + PDF
   ===================================================================== */
$('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    analysisResults = null;
    currentTranscript = '';
    audioFile = null;
    audioInput.value = '';
    $('fileChip').classList.remove('show');
    dropzone.style.display = 'block';
    $('fallbackBox').classList.remove('show');

$('pdfBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!analysisResults) return;

Done. The file is at `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\Documents\Default Project\index.html` — I tested it in the browser: no console errors, the full results view renders correctly (verified with a sample 93% passing evaluation), Groq's API is reachable directly from the browser (CORS check returned a clean 401 rather than a network block), the key modal saves/reads correctly, and validation errors show properly.

## What it does

Identical flow and design to the reference site:

1. **Upload Recording** — drag/click MP3 (up to 20 MB), with duration detection, or "paste the transcript instead" fallback
2. **Call Details** — agent name, date, customer, phone, dealership, disposition
3. **Evaluation & Coaching** — grade banner, auto-fail banner, 5-section QA breakdown of all 18 metrics, strengths/development/concerns, coaching plan with verbatim script suggestions, coaching notes, full transcript, PDF download

**How the AI part works (single file, no serverless functions):**
- Transcription: Groq `whisper-large-v3`, called directly from the browser
- Scoring: Groq `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` (auto-falls back to `llama-3.1-8b-instant`) in JSON mode
- The LLM only returns pass/partial/fail statuses + observations — **all point math, section totals, and the 85% pass threshold are computed in JavaScript**, so grades are always arithmetically correct and consistent
- The API key is pasted once via the **⚙ API Key** button in the header and saved to that browser's localStorage (get a free key at console.groq.com/keys — no credit card)

## Deploy to Netlify

1. Rename nothing — the file is already `index.html`
2. Drag the folder onto [app.netlify.com/drop](https://app.netlify.com/drop), **or** push it to a repo and import it in Netlify — either way it serves at `/audio-analyzer` if you place it in an `audio-analyzer/` folder, or at `/` as the site root
3. First visit: click ⚙ API Key and paste your Groq key

One note: because the key lives in the browser, each user pastes their own key (or you paste one on a shared/kiosk machine). If you'd rather have a single hidden server-side key instead, that's the Netlify Functions variant — just say the word and I'll build it.

## [Get All Available Models](#get-all-available-models)

Hosted models are directly accessible through the GroqCloud Models API endpoint using the model IDs mentioned above. You can use the `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models` endpoint to return a JSON list of all active models:

Python

```
curl -X GET "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $GROQ_API_KEY" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```
import Groq from "groq-sdk";

const groq = new Groq({ apiKey: process.env.GROQ_API_KEY });

const getModels = async () => {
  return await groq.models.list();
};

getModels().then((models) => {
  // console.log(models);
});
```

```
import requests
import os

api_key = os.environ.get("GROQ_API_KEY")
url = "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models"

headers = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

print(response.json())
```

content.text:
Fixed. The root cause: **Groq moved the Llama models to Enterprise tier** — on their current docs, `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` and `llama-3.1-8b-instant` are both marked "Enterprise / Contact Sales", so a free/dev key can't use them (hence "does not exist or you do not have access").

## What changed in `index.html`

1. **New model list** — `openai/gpt-oss-120b` first, then `openai/gpt-oss-20b`. These are Groq's current developer-tier models with listed prepaid pricing, and both officially support structured JSON output. Llama IDs remain as last-ditch candidates for enterprise accounts.

2. **Live model discovery** — before scoring, the page now calls `GET /v1/models` with your key and picks from the models you can *actually* use (preference-ordered, filtered to exclude Whisper/safety/embedding models). If discovery fails, it falls back to the static list. This means a future model shuffle won't break the page again.

3. **Two-tier retry logic** — per candidate model it tries JSON mode first; if that model rejects `response_format`, it retries the same model with plain prompting (my `tryParseJSON` already strips fences/extracts braces); if the model is unavailable entirely, it moves to the next one. `max_tokens` also raised 4000 → 8000 since GPT-OSS is a reasoning model and can spend tokens reasoning before emitting the JSON.

4. **Clearer errors** — invalid/rejected keys now say exactly that instead of a generic failure.

I verified the updated file loads with zero console errors and that the discovery + error path behaves correctly (a bad key produces the friendly "API key was rejected…" message rather than a crash).

**To deploy:** replace the `index.html` in your Netlify site with this updated file (drag-and-drop over it in the Netlify UI, or push to your repo), and re-run an analysis. Transcription worked for you already, so with the new scoring models you should get a full result.
