The user wants: metrics #3 (Reason for Transfer) and #6 (Warm Transfer Protocol) should be conditional on the Call Disposition field containing the word "Transfer". If disposition doesn't contain "Transfer", those metrics are deactivated (N/A — excluded from scoring). If it contains "Transfer", they're active.

Need to decide: does deactivation change the possible total (out of 100)? Metrics 3 (8 pts) and 6 (8 pts) are in sections 2 (24) and 3 (21). If deactivated, they should presumably become N/A and the denominator shrinks — the grade should be computed as percentage of available points.

Current grade calculation: total = sum earned over rows 1-15, grade = total (out of 100). If 16 points are unavailable, a perfect call would score 84/100 → unfair. So we should scale: grade = total / possibleActive * 100, rounded.

Done — metrics **#3 Reason for Transfer** and **#6 Warm Transfer Protocol** are now conditional on the Call Disposition field.

## How it works

**Rule:** the disposition is scanned for the word `Transfer` (case-insensitive).

| Disposition | Effect |
|---|---|
| `Warm Transfer – Service` | Both metrics **active** — scored normally, form is 100 pts |
| `Service Appointment` (no "Transfer") | Both metrics **deactivated** — grayed out with a `DEACTIVATED` chip, shown as N/A, worth 0 pts and **removed from the denominator** |

**Scoring impact:** the grade is now `earned ÷ available points × 100`, so deactivating a metric never unfairly punishes the agent — a perfect call without Transfer metrics scores 84/84 = 100%, not 84%.

- Section totals adjust automatically: Section 2 shows `16/16` (was 24), Section 3 shows `13/13` (was 21)
- Grade banner shows `77 / 84 pts scored (Transfer metrics deactivated)` when applicable
- Summary strip gets a new **Transfer Metrics** item: `✓ Active — scored` or `⊘ Deactivated — no "Transfer" in disposition`
- The AI prompt now includes the disposition plus an explicit rule telling it how to score (or deactivate) metrics 3 and 6 — but the client-side check is authoritative, so the result is correct regardless of what the model answers

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a single self-contained `index.html` the user can deploy to Netlify that replicates the CSR Call Evaluator at https://df-automated-auditform.netlify.app/audio-analyzer (upload audio → transcribe → score against an 18-metric QA form with coaching output).

## Requirements
- Must be ONE HTML file deployable to Netlify (no serverless functions).
- Chosen backend: free Groq API called directly from the browser; user pastes their Groq key once, saved in browser localStorage (no server-side secrets).
- Replicate the reference site's 3-step UI (Upload → Call Details → Evaluation & Coaching), 18-metric / 5-section rubric, 85% passing threshold, auto-fail zero-tolerance items, PDF download.
- Latest additions: maximize Tab 3 panel width/height; add a "DealerFocus IO Call Link" field; metrics #3 Reason for Transfer and #6 Warm Transfer Protocol activate only if the disposition contains the word "Transfer", otherwise deactivated.

## Decisions
- Single-HTML + in-page API key chosen by user over Netlify Functions and over pure browser-speech option.
- Score arithmetic is authoritative in client JS (`normalizeResult`); the LLM only supplies statuses/observations/text.
- Grade computed as `earned ÷ available points × 100` so deactivated transfer metrics shrink the denominator instead of penalizing the agent.
- Models: Llama IDs are Enterprise-tier now (caused "does not exist or you do not have access"), so use `openai/gpt-oss-120b` → `openai/gpt-oss-20b` with live `/v1/models` discovery fallback chain.
- PDF uses export-mode class expansion + `pagebreak: {mode:['css','legacy'], before:'.qa-section', after:'.coach-card'}`; copy uses ClipboardItem rich-HTML with execCommand fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full page built with reference-site styling, steps, upload/drag-drop, transcript-paste fallback, call details, results rendering, coaching plan, PDF, all in `index.html`.
- Verified in browser: zero console errors; sample evaluation renders correctly (93% passing) with all sections/chips.
- CORS check confirmed Groq reachable from the browser (401 JSON on bad key, not a network block).
- Groq model fix: added `MODELS_URL`, `discoverModels()`, `CHAT_MODELS`, two-tier retry (JSON mode → plain output → next model), `max_tokens: 8000`, friendlier 401 message.
- PDF fix: export mode (opens `<details>`, un-clips transcript box, swaps textarea for plain clone div), adaptive html2canvas scale, page-break rules; verified 19-page PDF (19 JPEG page images, `/Count 19`) and later 13-page PDF — no dropped content.
- "📋 Copy Evaluation" button added next to Download Report; verified success message "✓ Evaluation & Coaching copied — paste it into Word, Gmail, or Google Docs."
- Layout: `.main` max-width 920px → 1440px; transcript box `65vh` (export/print override to auto); coaching notes `min-height: 320px`.
- DealerFocus IO Call Link field (full-width in Step 2), rendered in summary strip as validated `https?://` anchor `🔗 Open IO Call Link`, included in PDF/copy, cleared on reset.
- Transfer-conditional scoring for metrics 3 & 6: verified active case (disposition "Warm Transfer – Service" → grade 93, `93 / 100`, sections 24/24 & 21/21, chip "Pass") and inactive case ("Service Appointment" → grade 92 = 77/84, chips "Deactivated", sections 16/16 & 13/13, pts label "77 / 84 pts scored  (Transfer metrics deactivated)", summary "⊘ Deactivated — no \"Transfer\" in disposition").
- Prompt rule `6. DISPOSITION RULE` verified emitting correct text both ways; PDF regen after change succeeded (985719 bytes) with no errors.

### Active
- (none) — all user requests implemented and verified locally; awaiting user deployment/retest feedback.

### Blocked
- Screenshots unavailable (`browser.screenshot` → "Screenshot needs a visible tab... keep its desktop window visible"); verification done via DOM measurements, PDF byte/page analysis instead.

- ☐ Correct data entered — first name, last name, phone · item 12

- **Item 8** — same as item 4.

## Objective
- Build a single self-contained `index.html` deployable to Netlify that replicates the CSR Call Evaluator (upload audio → transcribe → score against the DealerFocus 18→26-item QA form with coaching output, PDF/copy export), with the evaluation sheet rebuilt from `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\Documents\Audit Sample.pdf`.

## Requirements
- ONE HTML file, no serverless functions; free Groq API called from the browser; key pasted once and stored in localStorage (`groq_api_key`, header button `⚙ API Key`).
- Replicate 3-step UI (Upload → Call Details → Evaluation & Coaching), 100-point rubric, 85% passing threshold, auto-fail zero-tolerance items, PDF download, Copy button.
- Evaluation sheet wording must match the user's pasted form text exactly (section and item wording).
- Item 4 Customer Verification, 7 Drop-Off Duration, 8 Email/Text Feature: "doing the step is enough — award full points whenever the item was obtained during the call, whether the agent asked for it or the caller volunteered it"; item 7 additionally "regardless of whatever the transportation is". User chose the option "Pass unless the detail contradicts the caller" (contradiction → partial/fail, e.g. caller Colleen vs agent "Ms. Pauline Lee").
- Item 13 Transfer Handling: "Award full point if Call disposition did not contain 'Transfer'.. Evaluate if otherwise."
- System & Scheduler items 10/11/12/15 scored from a checklist on the Call Details tab (unchecked = 0 pts, checked = full), overriding the AI.
- Call Management Skills (items 17–23) must be a MANUAL evaluation (auditor ratings on Call Details tab), never judged by the AI.
- Call Details block on the Evaluation & Coaching results must mirror the Call Details tab fields/labels/order.

## Decisions
- Score arithmetic is authoritative in client JS (`normalizeResult`); LLM only supplies statuses/observations/text; checklist and manual ratings override the model.
- Grade = earned ÷ available points × 100; N/A items (model `na`) shrink the denominator; transfer item no longer N/A (gets full points instead, denominator back to 100).
- Models: `openai/gpt-oss-120b` → `openai/gpt-oss-20b` with live `/v1/models` discovery fallback; two-tier retry (JSON mode → plain → next model); `max_tokens: 16000`.
- Failed generation (Groq `failed_generation` / "Failed to generate JSON") now falls through to the next model instead of aborting.
- Observations capped at 25 words, recommendations 15 words (prevents truncation).
- PDF: export-mode class expansion + `pagebreak: {mode:['css','legacy'], before:'.qa-section', after:'.coach-card'}`; copy uses ClipboardItem with execCommand fallback.
- Real-call testing done by serving the mp3 from a local PowerShell HttpListener (port 8765, script `serve-audio.ps1`) and loading it into the file input via fetch + DataTransfer; listener stopped after each run.

## Work State
### Completed
- Rubric replaced with PDF form: 26 items / 6 sections / 100 pts (Call Flow 10, Confirming 10, Body of the call 25, System & Scheduler 27, Call Management 28, Zero Tolerance 0); section names now plain (no "1 — " prefixes).
- Item wording updated to the user's pasted form text verbatim (items 1–23); verified present in rendered sheet and AI prompt.
- Accuracy/step-based rule (items 4, 7, 8) implemented in criteria + prompt rule 6 with contradiction-only exception; transportation clause added for item 7.
- Transfer rule changed from N/A to full-points for non-transfer dispositions; prompt rule 4 rewritten to be correct in both branches.
- System & Scheduler checklist card on Call Details (chkOpCode/chkAdvisor/chkData/chkHotAlert → items 10/11/12/15), prompt block, client override both directions, summary line `System Checklist n/4 verified`, cleared on reset.
- Call Management manual evaluation card (`cms17`–`cms23` selects, 0–4), `MANUAL_SKILLS` + `readManualSkills()`, blocking validation ("Rate all 7 Call Management Skills…"), prompt `manualBlock`, client override, summary line `Call Management Skills Manual — n/28 pts`, cleared on reset.
- Results summary strip mirrors Call Details: Agent Name, Call Date, Customer Name, Customer Phone #, Dealership Name, Call Disposition, DealerFocus IO Call Link, Reason for Call, Transfer Handling (13), System Checklist, Call Management Skills.
- Reset clears checklist boxes and manual selects; PDF/copy verified earlier (10 pages, 1.81 MB, no errors).
- Live verification runs of `Ericka-CAN.mp3`: earlier 45% → 58% → 72% (ticked) → final run with checklist 4/4 and ratings 4/2/3/3/4/3/3 = **86/100 → 86% Passing**, sections 10/10, 7/10, 20/25, 27/27, 22/28, no auto-fail, zero console errors.
- Audit script confirmed both features: prompt blocks present, override affects only items 10/11/12/15 and 17–23, no stale wording.

### Active
- (none) — all user requests implemented and verified locally.

### Blocked
- Screenshots unavailable (`browser.screenshot` needs a visible desktop tab); verification done via DOM/evaluate and PDF byte analysis.

## Next Move
1. User to redeploy `index.html` to Netlify and re-test with a real call + their Groq key (all changes are uncommitted and undeployed).
2. If scoring seems off: item 7 flipped fail→pass between runs because the step-based rule is lenient on borderline transcript evidence — user may ask to tighten it.

## Relevant Files
- `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\Documents\Default Project\index.html`: entire deliverable (CSS, markup, RUBRIC/SECTIONS/CHECKLIST/MANUAL_SKILLS, normalizeResult, buildScoringPrompt, groqTranscribe/groqScore/discoverModels, renderResults, export handlers).
- `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\Documents\Audit Sample.pdf`: source evaluation sheet (3 image-only pages).
- `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\Downloads\Ericka-CAN.mp3`: test recording used for live evaluations.
- `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\serve-audio.ps1`: local CORS file server (port 8765) for loading the mp3 into the page; `audit-render-1..3.png` are the rendered PDF pages.

## Important Context
- Groq endpoints: `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions` (whisper-large-v3), `/openai/v1/chat/completions`, `/openai/v1/models`; `MAX_BYTES = 20MB`, `PASSING_THRESHOLD = 85`, `CHAT_MODELS = ['openai/gpt-oss-120b','openai/gpt-oss-20b','llama-3.3-70b-versatile','llama-3.1-8b-instant']`.
- Key constants: `RUBRIC` ids 1–26 (`FIRST_ID`/`LAST_ID`), `SECTIONS` (6, plain names), `CHECKLIST` (10,11,12,15), `MANUAL_SKILLS` (17–23, keys `cms17`…`cms23`), `ZERO_IDS_LABEL`.
- Prompt rules order: 1 scoring range (1–16; 17–23 manual; zero-tolerance ids), 2 zero-tolerance, 3 N/A column, 4 disposition/transfer, 5 evidence, 6 step-based items 4/7/8, 7 observation brevity, 8 grade math; plus `checklistBlock` and `manualBlock`.
- Test tab used: `tab_205f5c91-42cd-4ae0-af25-b4e69428deb9` via `browser.preview` on `file:///C:/Users/Cebuana%20Guest/Documents/Default%20Project/index.html`; no Python/Node on this machine.
- PDF verification trick: extract embedded JPEGs (scan `FF D8 FF`…`FF D9`); count ≈ page count; files land under `C:\Users\Cebuana Guest\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\` and `opencode-browser-client-*`.
- Changes are uncommitted/undeployed; the session directory is not a git repo — user deploys manually.

Done — coaching now quotes the flagged line + a better spiel, and your four revised Accuracy Rules are in. Verified with a live run (0 console errors).

## New coaching format
Every flagged item's **Coaching** box now renders two lines:

> **Coaching:** **Customer's line:** "My name is Colleen."
> **Better spiel:** "Thank you, Colleen, I have you as..."

Prompt rule 7 enforces it: part 1 = the customer's exact words at the moment the agent was flagged (falls back to **Agent's line:** "…" for flags with no customer line — silence, sigh), part 2 = the verbatim better spiel, always present, real transcript words only (no invented `"..."` placeholders). Empty only when the item got full points. The coaching-plan cards' `example` field was updated to the same pattern.

## Revised Accuracy Rules (items 17–23)
| Skill | Rule now in the sheet + prompt |
|---|---|
| Hold Procedure | Full if silence < 1 min · Partial if agent went quiet **without prior notice regardless of length** · Fail if all rules not followed |
| Communication & Delivery | Full if the customer **did not** say "I can't understand you" · Partial if they had to ask to repeat/slow down · Fail if they said it |
| Empathy | Full if emotion acknowledged **regardless of how it is done** · Partial if acknowledged **without assurance of assistance** · Fail if ignored |
| Tone of Voice | Full if the agent **kept calm** · Partial if a **sigh was recorded** · Fail if patience lost / voice raised |

(Active Listening, Efficiency, Confidence keep their previous rules — you didn't list them.)

## Live run (Ericka-CAN.mp3, checklist 4/4)
**81% — 81/100** · Call Flow 10/10 · Confirming 7/10 · Body 20/25 · System & Scheduler 24/27 (checklist items 10/11/12/15 all forced full; item 14 lost 3) · **Call Management 20/28** · no auto-fail.

- **17 Hold — partial 2/4:** *"Agent went silent while checking calendar without announcing a hold"* → `Agent's line: "..." → Better spiel: "One moment please while I check the schedule."`
- **18 Comm & Delivery — pass 4/4:** *"Customer never asked for repetition"* (new rule applied)
- **19 Empathy — partial 2/4:** *"'Okay, okay' but did not acknowledge frustration"* → `Better spiel: "I understand this is frustrating; we'll look into the tire sensor and remote issues."`
- **21 Tone — pass 4/4:** *"calm, courteous tone throughout"*
- Non-skill rows also picked up the format (e.g. item 2: `Customer's line: "My name is Colleen."`)

The new rules made the scoring noticeably fairer (0/28 → 20/28). Local server stopped — `index.html` is ready to redeploy.
